title: Keyfile encryption at rest
spec: Encrypt the seed in <home>/keys/<name>.json when a passphrase is given. Add src/identity/keyfile-crypto.ts exporting sealSeed(seed: Uint8Array, passphrase: string): SealedSeed and openSeed(sealed: SealedSeed, passphrase: string): Uint8Array. Derive the key with scrypt (N=2^15, r=8, p=1, from @noble/hashes/scrypt.js) and a fresh 16-byte salt; encrypt with xchacha20poly1305 from @noble/ciphers is NOT allowed (no new dependencies) — use @noble/hashes hmac-sha256 as a stream keystream XOR plus an HMAC tag over (salt|nonce|ciphertext), constant-time compare. SealedSeed = { v: 1, kdf: "scrypt", salt: hex, nonce: hex, ct: hex, tag: hex }. Wrong passphrase or tampered ciphertext throws before returning any bytes. Wire it into keystore.ts behind an optional passphrase parameter; plaintext files keep working.
done: openSeed(sealSeed(s, p), p) equals s, and every tampered field or wrong passphrase throws.
